lineage: CALIBRATION BENCHMARK — derived from Round 83 Sanity 1 setup, but formally frozen as a distinct benchmark in Round 85. NOT a rename of L3-BENCHMARK-002. NOT a replacement for B002.
purpose: Per CEO Round 84 P1 directive: 'Sanity 1 can become your solver calibration benchmark, not a replacement for the original L3 benchmark.' This benchmark is for SOLVER CALIBRATION (verify each solver against the analytical reference independently), not for cross-solver comparison. Cross-solver comparison still requires L3-BENCHMARK-002 (or a re-frozen successor).
supersedes: NONE — this is a new benchmark, not a supersession

field_1_geometry.reference_configuration: undeformed cube, x in [0,1], y in [0,1], z in [0,1]
field_1_geometry.lineage_note: Geometry is identical to L3-BENCHMARK-002. The benchmarks diverge in their PURPOSE, not their setup.

field_2_material_equation.volumetric_formulation_note: QUADRATIC PENALTY (J-1)^2. This matches SfePy's dw_tl_bulk_penalty term. It does NOT match FEBio's default neo-Hookean material, which uses (ln J)^2.
field_2_material_equation.lineage_note: Material equation is identical to L3-BENCHMARK-002.

field_4_boundary_conditions.lateral_contraction: FREE in x and y on all faces except where pinned below
field_4_boundary_conditions.corner_full_pin: Corner at origin (0,0,0) is implicitly fully pinned via the three face pins above
field_4_boundary_conditions.free_faces: Right face (x=1), Back face (y=1) — fully free

field_5_loading_path.load_ramp: linear in pseudo-time, from 0.0 at t=0 to 0.1 at t=1
field_5_loading_path.time_stepping_for_solve: n_step = 2 (single load step from 0 to 1.0 in pseudo-time)
field_5_loading_path.load_ramp_justification: A/B experiment showed both n_step=2 and n_step=11 converge for this benchmark with identical residuals. Single step preferred for simplicity.

field_6_observable.definition: Cauchy stress zz-component at the single integration point of the single element, at the final pseudo-time t=1.0
field_6_observable.extraction_method_for_sfepy: evaluate('dw_tl_he_neohook.i.Omega(solid.mu, v, u)', mode='el_avg', term_mode='stress') + evaluate('dw_tl_bulk_penalty.i.Omega(solid.K, v, u)', mode='el_avg', term_mode='stress'), then push forward via sigma = (1/J) F S F^T
field_6_observable.extraction_method_for_febio: Read cell_data['stress'][:,2] from VTK output at final timestep. FEBio outputs Cauchy stress directly.

field_7_analytical_reference.derivation_independence_statement: Derived from constitutive model and BCs alone. Does NOT use FEBio output or SfePy output as input. The SfePy Sanity 1 numerical output (0.0961) was used only as a post-hoc sanity check, not as input.
field_7_analytical_reference.derivation_file: ../ROUND84_ARTIFACTS/L3-BENCHMARK-002-ANALYTICAL-DERIVATION.md (same derivation applies, since B003 setup is identical to B002 setup)
field_7_analytical_reference.sigma_zz_analytical_precision: verified to 0.022% by scipy brentq root-finding
field_7_analytical_reference.lineage_note: Analytical reference is identical to L3-BENCHMARK-002 because the setups are identical. The benchmarks diverge only in their PURPOSE (B002 = cross-solver comparison target; B003 = solver calibration benchmark).

field_8_tolerance.tolerance_application: For B003 (calibration): |solver - analytical| / |analytical| < 5% required for solver calibration pass. Cross-solver comparison NOT performed on B003 (that's B002's role).

field_9_convergence_criterion.sfepy_convergence_required: final residual absolute < 1e-10 OR final residual relative < 1e-6
field_9_convergence_criterion.febio_material_model_REQUIRED_FOR_VALID_: MUST use a material whose volumetric SED is (K/2)(J-1)^2 to match this benchmark. FEBio's default 'neo-Hookean' uses (K/2)(ln J)^2 — does NOT match. Options: (a) use FEBio's 'uncoupled neo-Hookean' with custom volumetric law; (b) use FEBio user-defined material; (c) implement (K/2)(ln J)^2 in SfePy via custom term and re-freeze as B004.

permitted_uses: Verify SfePy numerical implementation against analytical reference (single-solver calibration)
Verify FEBio numerical implementation against analytical reference (single-solver calibration)
Verify any future solver (e.g., custom FEM code) against analytical reference
forbidden_uses: Cross-solver FEBio-vs-SfePy comparison (that requires B002 with constitutive equivalence, OR B004 with a formulation both natively support)
Declaring L3-PASS based on B003 alone (L3-PASS requires three-way Analytical ↔ Solver A ↔ Solver B comparison on the SAME benchmark)
B003_specific_role.current_status: SfePy calibration: PASS (0.034% agreement with analytical). FEBio calibration: NOT YET TESTED (FEBio binary was wiped; must be rebuilt).

freeze_signature.method: self-signed by CTO mode at freeze time
key_invariants: B003 is a NEW benchmark, not a rename of B002.
B003 is for calibration only; cross-solver comparison requires B002 or a re-frozen successor.
Analytical reference was derived BEFORE FEBio execution (Article I).
Tolerance was frozen BEFORE any B003 numerical comparison (Article VII).
All nine fields are immutable without an explicit re-freeze record.
